Please note that specific details, terms, and conditions would need to be thoroughly discussed and inserted by the parties involved.

---

**GENERAL FINANCIAL AGREEMENT**

This General Financial Agreement (the "Agreement") is made and entered into on this \[Day] day of \[Month], \[Year],

**BETWEEN:**

1.  **\[Party A Name]**, son/daughter/wife of \[Father's/Husband's Name], holding National Identity Card (CNIC) No. \[CNIC Number], residing at \[Address], (hereinafter referred to as "Party A," which expression shall, where the context so admits, include its successors-in-interest, legal representatives, and assigns)

**AND**

2.  **\[Party B Name]**, son/daughter/wife of \[Father's/Husband's Name], holding National Identity Card (CNIC) No. \[CNIC Number], residing at \[Address], (hereinafter referred to as "Party B," which expression shall, where the context so admits, include its successors-in-interest, legal representatives, and assigns)

(Party A and Party B are hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Parties" and individually as a "Party").

**WHEREAS:**

A.  Party A and Party B desire to enter into a financial arrangement as more specifically described herein.
B.  The Parties agree to be bound by the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement.

**NOW, THEREFORE,** in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows:

**1. PURPOSE AND SCOPE OF AGREEMENT**
    This Agreement outlines the terms and conditions governing the financial relationship and obligations between Party A and Party B concerning \[*Clearly define the nature of the financial agreement, e.g., a loan, an investment, a payment plan, etc.*].

**2. FINANCIAL OBLIGATIONS AND PAYMENT TERMS**
    2.1.   **Amount:** Party \[*A/B*] agrees to provide to Party \[*B/A*] the principal sum of PKR \[*Amount in Figures*] (Pakistani Rupees \[*Amount in Words*]).
    2.2.   **Purpose:** The aforementioned sum is provided for the purpose of \[*State the specific purpose, e.g., business investment, personal loan, etc.*].
    2.3.   **Repayment Schedule:** Party \[*Recipient*] shall repay the said sum to Party \[*Provider*] in the following manner: \[*Specify detailed repayment schedule, e.g., in [Number] equal monthly installments of PKR [Amount] each, commencing from [Date], or a lump sum payment on [Date].*]
    2.4.   **Interest (if applicable):** An interest rate of \[*Percentage*]% per annum shall be applied to the outstanding principal amount, calculated \[*Specify calculation method, e.g., monthly, annually, simple, compound*].
    2.5.   **Mode of Payment:** All payments shall be made via \[*Specify method, e.g., bank transfer to Account No. [...], Cheque, Cash*] to Party \[*Recipient of Payment*].
    2.6.   **Late Payment Penalties (if applicable):** In the event of a delay in payment beyond the agreed due date, a penalty of \[*Specify penalty, e.g., [Percentage]% of the overdue amount per day/week/month, or a fixed late fee of PKR [Amount]*] shall be levied.

**3. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES**
    Each Party represents and warrants to the other Party that:
    3.1.   It has the full legal right, power, and authority to enter into and perform its obligations under this Agreement.
    3.2.   The execution and delivery of this Agreement and the performance of its obligations hereunder will not conflict with or violate any other agreement to which it is a party.
    3.3.   All information provided to the other Party in connection with this Agreement is true, accurate, and complete.

**4. COVENANTS AND UNDERTAKINGS**
    4.1.   Each Party shall perform its obligations hereunder in good faith and in accordance with the terms of this Agreement.
    4.2.   \[*Include any specific undertakings, e.g., Party B shall provide regular financial updates to Party A, Party A shall not demand repayment before a certain date, etc.*]

**5. CONFIDENTIALITY**
    The Parties agree to keep confidential all non-public information exchanged between them in connection with this Agreement, including the terms of this Agreement, and shall not disclose such information to any third party without the prior written consent of the other Party, except as required by law.

**6. EVENTS OF DEFAULT**
    The occurrence of any of the following shall constitute an "Event of Default" under this Agreement:
    6.1.   Failure by Party \[*Recipient of Funds/Obligor*] to make any payment when due under this Agreement.
    6.2.   Breach of any material term or condition of this Agreement by either Party.
    6.3.   Any representation or warranty made by a Party proves to be untrue or misleading in any material respect.

**7. INDEMNIFICATION**
    Each Party agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the other Party from and against any and all claims, liabilities, damages, losses, and expenses (including reasonable legal fees) arising out of or in connection with any breach of this Agreement by the indemnifying Party.

**8. ASSIGNMENT**
    Neither Party shall assign or transfer its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other Party.

**9. SET-OFF (if applicable)**
    Party A shall have the right, but not the obligation, to set-off any amounts owed to it by Party B against any amounts payable by Party A to Party B under this Agreement or any other agreement between the Parties.

**10. FORCE MAJEURE**
    Neither Party shall be liable for any failure or delay in performing its obligations under this Agreement if such failure or delay is caused by an event beyond its reasonable control, including but not limited to acts of God, war, terrorism, riots, embargoes, fires, floods, earthquakes, or other natural disasters.

**11. TERMINATION**
    11.1.  This Agreement may be terminated by mutual written consent of the Parties.
    11.2.  Either Party may terminate this Agreement immediately upon written notice to the other Party upon the occurrence of an Event of Default by the other Party, if such default is not cured within \[*Number*] days of receiving written notice thereof.

**12. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION**
    12.1.  This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
    12.2.  Any dispute, controversy, or claim arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, including its existence, validity, interpretation, performance, breach, or termination thereof, shall be referred to and finally resolved by \[*Choose one: arbitration in accordance with the provisions of the Arbitration Act, 1940 (as amended), or the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in [City, Pakistan]*].

**13. ENTIRE AGREEMENT**
    This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior discussions, negotiations, and agreements, whether oral or written.

**14. AMENDMENTS**
    No amendment, modification, or waiver of any provision of this Agreement shall be effective unless it is in writing and signed by duly authorized representatives of both Parties.
